title: Labelled break: Find a Pair
hints: You can name a loop with a label and `break` out of it from an inner loop.
Label the outer loop, record `[row, col]` when you find the target, then `break` the label.
`search: for (r, row) in grid.enumerated() { for (c, v) in row.enumerated() where v == target { found = [r, c]; break search } }`.
